provenance.loadAverage: about 80 (1-minute; 30 lanes compiling on the same machine)
provenance.method: Median of three local runs of metric / calibration, each metric divided by the same-run calibration measured on the same PGlite instance immediately before and after it (mean of the two; each calibration the median of 3 runs of 200 single-row inserts, 200 point selects, one scan and a JSON round trip). Replay: ordered PGlite replay through the real Clearinghouse handlers and the committed holiday-table SQL path. Each API p95: 20 uncached in-process Hono requests after two warm-ups. Ceilings are 8x the median ratio.
